correctness.rationale: The printed density becomes exactly \(y\beta^{-2}e^{-y/\beta}\) under \(y=x-I\), hence \(Y\sim\Gamma(2,\beta)\). Inverting \((1+z)e^{-z}=1-p\) requires the lower real branch \(W_{-1}\); the source expression instead has a positive Lambert-W argument and falls below the support. Direct integration of the printed survival gives \(m(t)=\beta(t-I+2\beta)/(t-I+\beta)\), whose derivative is strictly negative. A standalone high-precision checker independently verifies both identities and the failure of the printed formulas.

value.rationale: Quantiles and mean residual life are central advertised statistical and reliability properties of the NMED. The published quantile fails even the support test, while the published residual-life theorem reverses the true monotonicity and drives a displayed plot. The shifted-gamma identity gives exact replacements and a coherent reliability interpretation, making the correction mathematically substantive and directly reusable.
